title: A merge trial that failed while its containers waited for the CPU to cool is queued again, not sent back
description: A seeded trial whose test timed out while its containers waited over a minute on a hot CPU goes through the real merge writer and control plane: the item stays in the merge queue with the note 'trial slowed by heat, retried' and no rework; the third heat failure raises one attention line. A shorter heat wait, or none, is a red head as before.

steps.name: A heat-slowed trial is retried without rework
